attempts.text:
The only designated evacuation point is Trishuli shelter, so Dupcheshwar temple cannot be used as a drop-off. The Trishuli to Naukunda road is closed, so Naukunda must be reached via Gosaikunda. I assumed the shopkeepers count as adults.

- **Naukunda farm:** the round trip is 11 + 12 minutes each way, 46 minutes, to rescue 4 adults. Deferring them would cost 80, so this is worth doing.
- **Dupcheshwar temple:** the round trip is 11 + 25 minutes each way, 72 minutes, to rescue 4 adults. Deferring them would cost 80, so rescuing is slightly better.
- **Bidur village:** reaching the 2 shopkeepers costs at least 116 minutes round trip, against a deferral penalty of 40. I defer them.

Total cost is 46 + 72 + 40 = 158.

drive car1 gosaikunda-temple naukunda-farm
